Institution FAQs
Who owns the student data?
The roster you upload is yours. The resume is the student’s. Information derived from a resume, such as a completeness or quality score, is computed under that student’s consent and stops appearing in your dashboard and exports if they withdraw it.
What if a student refuses to consent?
They stay on your roster and still count against your seats. Their resume will not open and their quality columns export blank, with the row marked. They can consent later at any time.
Do students have to pay?
No. Every student on your roster keeps a permanent Global ID and live resume links for life, at no cost, including after graduation and after your agreement ends. Other agreement benefits apply while they are enrolled.
What happens at the end of the academic year?
Nothing automatic. The institution removes the batch that has graduated when ready. Nobody loses their CV-MAKER account or identity when the batch is removed.
Is the quality score used to decide who gets placed?
No. It is advisory, to help students see where to improve and officers know whom to coach. It does not gate anyone from a drive.
How long does it take to get a college running?
Roster upload itself takes minutes. The main variable is how quickly students activate their accounts and consent, which the dashboard makes visible.
Can we try it before committing?
Yes. The pilot lets the institution try the workflow before committing. Ask for a demo to discuss an arrangement that fits your batch size.
